doc: Runs a per-frame update via func_80043EB8, then, if D_80082E6E.field_0 is set, primes D_80081500 with func_8003F794(6,8) and installs func_80043E60 as the next state handler via func_80040A88; otherwise falls back to func_8003D92C.

globals.name: D_80081500
globals.decl: extern s16 D_80081500;  // %gp_rel small scalar, sh-written here with func_8003F794(6,8)'s result

globals.name: D_80082E6E
globals.decl: extern struct { u8 field_0; u8 pad[8]; } D_80082E6E;  // only field_0 (byte) touched; padded >8 bytes so gcc emits %hi/%lo addressing instead of %gp_rel, matching target asm

calls: func_80040A88(int a0) -> void  // installs a1-typeless function pointer as next-state callback
